about: The mutant ledger of runtime/explore: edits that runtime/explore's TestSearchAgreesWithReference or the lowering's TestKeyEqualsEquality must kill. scripts/mutants judges only check and lower today (follow-up of wf10 X1); until it has an explore suite, a unit that changes the package applies each edit by hand and runs the killer.

mutants.name: x1-explore-map-unsorted
mutants.from: slices.SortFunc(entries, func(a, b []byte) int { return compareBytes(a, b) })
mutants.rule: Key: a Map writes its entries in the order of their encodings, so Go's map order does not show.

mutants.name: x1-explore-budget-proved
mutants.to:
r.Checked = depth - 1
					r.Complete = true
					return r
mutants.rule: Search: a search the budget stops is not Complete (never reported proved).

mutants.name: x1-explore-start-unchecked
mutants.rule: Search: the starts are checked against the target, the start included.

mutants.name: x1-explore-revisit-new
mutants.rule: Search: a state seen before (an Ignore or Reject edge included) is no new state.

mutants.name: x1-explore-parent-off
mutants.from:
r.nodes = append(r.nodes, node{parent: int32(ids[f]), sig: int32(e)})
				r.States++
mutants.to:
r.nodes = append(r.nodes, node{parent: int32(ids[f]) - 1, sig: int32(e)})
				r.States++
mutants.rule: Result.Run: the run to a node replays to it.

mutants.name: x1-explore-hash-8-bits
mutants.rule: Key.Sum: the visited set holds 128-bit hashes; a narrow hash merges states (a false proved).

mutants.name: x1-explore-changes-self
mutants.rule: Changes: a random walk picks only signals that move to another state.

mutants.name: x1-explore-path-layer-shared
mutants.from:
for d := 1; d < len(targets) && len(ids) > 0; d++ {
		layer = map[Hash]struct{}{}
mutants.to: for d := 1; d < len(targets) && len(ids) > 0; d++ {
mutants.rule: Path: each layer keeps its own visited set.

mutants.name: x1-explore-checked-depth
mutants.rule: Search: Checked is the run length up to which every run was checked.

mutants.name: x1-key-string-length
mutants.rule: Key.String: a string is written with its length.

mutants.name: x1-key-float-one-zero
mutants.rule: Key.Float: a float is written by its bits, so 0 and -0, which a step tells apart, are two states (types.md Laws 13).

mutants.name: b15-r7-search-retains-frontier
mutants.rule: Search pending layers retain node indexes, not whole model payloads; FrontierStates counts their actual retained payloads.

mutants.name: b15-r7-path-retains-frontier
mutants.rule: Path pending layers retain node indexes, not whole model payloads.

mutants.name: b15-r7-frontier-replay-skips-signal
mutants.rule: A materialized frontier state replays every signal of its shortest run, and agrees with the retained-state reference.
